finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: if the email content is larger than the allocated buffer size
finding.assumptions: The 'ptr' buffer is not allocated or its size is not checked against 'len'.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: if the email content contains malicious characters
finding.assumptions: The content of 'email_data_str' is attacker-controlled and may contain special characters that could be interpreted by the shell.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: if the error message contains malicious characters
finding.assumptions: The error message returned by 'curl_easy_strerror' could be influenced by the server response or configuration.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: if the output is redirected to a file or another process
finding.assumptions: The output could be redirected to a file or another process that could be influenced by an attacker.
